d:
The beginning of winter and early snowfall create new issues for the crew as they face the start of Alaska’s winter and a reckoning in the Wylde Mountains. With the snowfall already threatening to derail their projects, harsh conditions may prove to be more than they bargained for.
: Intervention Tuesdays at 8P on Discovery
Stream Homestead Rescue: Intervention on Discovery+
About Homestead Rescue: Intevention
Struggling homesteaders too proud or stubborn to ask for help are ambushed when their loved ones call in the Raneys for a make-or-break rescue.
